_note_success_tiers: Three distinct ✅ categories — do not collapse into one.

SUCCESS.description: Pure green light — check passed, test passed, connection established, it works. e.g. Device Check, Joined, Authentication Complete, Refreshed.

SAVED.description: Something was configured or stored — setting applied, setup saved, update committed. e.g. Updated, Setup Complete, Set Ticket Moderators context.

DONE.description: An action was executed and enacted — something was created, removed, approved, submitted. e.g. Ticket Created, Approved, Member Removed, Request Submitted, Purge Complete.

ERROR.description: Any failure — error, not found, access denied, invalid, failed, timed out, already exists, DMs disabled. Single catch-all for all ❌ states.

WARNING.description: Caution state — automod trigger, already verified, pending request, system error notice, media-only channel.

PENDING.description: Waiting / in progress — waiting for image upload, pending interrogation, fetching messages.

TIMER.description: Time / duration / progress value display (not a state — inline in status text).

BOT.description: Bot / AI identity marker — Shantha speaking, AI analyzing, bot status header.

UPTIME.description: Uptime / connectivity — inline label in /status output.

OFFLINE.description: Inactive / not connected indicator (voice offline in /status).

LOCK.description: Lock / close — close ticket button, ticket closed log, permission denied message.

BELL.description: Notification / escalation — escalate to staff button, ping content, ticket escalation.

SHIELD.description: Moderator / protection — set ticket mods title, ticket-setup mods field, server verification title.

KEYLOCK.description: Secure gate — role verification embed title (the gate users must pass).

TICKET.description: Ticket identity — open ticket modal value, ticket welcome embed title.

PANEL.description: Support panel header — ticket-setup dashboard embed, private VC channel name prefix.

EDIT.description: Edit / pen — edit ticket embed modal title, edit embed text button label.

TYPE.description: Ticket type prefix — text/vc ticket modal titles and setup button labels.

LABEL.description: Button label / title field — modal input placeholder for button name.

PAYMENT.description: Payment / card — default value placeholder in image reply modal.

PURGE.description: Delete / purge — purge complete embed title.

CLIPBOARD.description: Info list / clipboard — tkt_action text reply title, queue display in /status.

IMAGE.description: Image / media — tkt_action image reply title.

MUSIC.description: Music / currently playing — inline label in /status voice section.

VOICE.description: Voice channel active / volume — inline label in /status.

MAILBOX.description: Auto-DM setting — inline in setup-verification reply description.

FRIENDS_ROLE.description: Friends-tier verification role — title prefix for friends verification request embeds.

MEMBER_ROLE.description: Member-tier verification role — title prefix for member verification request embeds.
